name: llama.cpp
notes: Baseline. GGUF files; CUDA, ROCm, Vulkan, Metal and CPU backends; supports partial GPU offload (-ngl, --n-cpu-moe).

name: Ollama
notes: Easiest install; built on llama.cpp. Usually a little slower; one test measured 61 vs 143 tok/s on an L40S, so treat this factor as provisional until calibrated from data.

name: LM Studio (GGUF)
notes: Desktop app wrapping llama.cpp; close to raw llama.cpp speed.

name: MLX / LM Studio MLX
notes: Apple Silicon only. Often faster than GGUF on Mac. MLX 4/6/8-bit roughly map to Q4/Q6/Q8 here.

name: vLLM
notes: Server engine. Single-stream speed roughly matches llama.cpp; wins on concurrent load (2.8–4.4x at 64 requests in one test). Needs the model fully in VRAM; 4-bit AWQ/GPTQ roughly maps to Q4 here.
